name: message-actions
title: Message actions
description: Status, feedback, copy and share under an assistant reply.

files.content:
'use client' import * as React from 'react' import { Clock, Copy, DoubleCheck, Link, ThumbsDown, ThumbsUp } from 'iconoir-react' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' import { Button } from '@/registry/satin/ui/button' /** * MessageActions, 1:1 with uiKit `_chat/answerActions` (901:20164): the row under an assistant * reply. Delivery status (16px icon in a 24px box) and time in text/muted medium 13, then like, * dislike and copy as 24px tertiary icon buttons 2px apart, then Share (tertiary xs with a * label). Groups sit 8px apart with 1 × 12 border/default dividers between them. * * Feedback: a clicked thumb stays pressed (border/input fill, icon text/subtle) until the other * one is clicked or it is clicked again; `feedback` sets it, `onFeedback` reports it. * The status and time show only when there is a `timestamp`. */ export type MessageFeedback = 'like' | 'dislike' | null export interface MessageActionsProps extends React.ComponentProps<'div'> { /** "20 minutes ago". Leave it out to drop the status and time. */ timestamp?: string status?: 'sending' | 'delivered' /** The pressed thumb. Pass it with onFeedback to control it, or once to start from it. */ feedback?: MessageFeedback showShare?: boolean onFeedback?: (value: MessageFeedback) => void onCopy?: () => void onShare?: () => void } const divider = export function MessageActions({ timestamp, status = 'delivered', feedback: feedbackProp = null, showShare = true, onFeedback, onCopy, onShare, className, ...props }: MessageActionsProps) { const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState(feedbackProp) React.useEffect(() => setFeedback(feedbackProp), [feedbackProp]) const toggle = (value: 'like' | 'dislike') => { const next = feedback === value ? null : value setFeedback(next) onFeedback?.(next) } const thumb = 'aria-pressed:bg-border-input aria-pressed:[&_svg]:text-text-subtle' return (
{timestamp && ( <> {status === 'sending' ? ( ) : ( )} {status === 'sending' ? 'Sending' : 'Delivered'} {timestamp} {divider} )} {showShare && ( <> {divider} )}
) }
